The site's RSS feed

Source: R/feed.R
mui_feed_xml.Rd

An RSS 2.0 document over the dated pages of the site, newest first. Built only when the configuration says feed: true; a feed: naming a URL is a feed the site does not own and is advertised in <head> without being generated.

Usage

mui_feed_xml(pages, config = mui_config())

Arguments

pages

Built pages carrying a date; see mui_build_site().

config

The site configuration; see mui_read_config().

Value

The feed document, as a string.

See also

Other render: mui_boot_script(), mui_prerender_html(), mui_render_page(), mui_trim_payload()
